minimal_failure.scope: One-minimal outage set conditional on fixed continuous disturbance. No causal attribution, global cardinality guarantee or physical temporal cascade.

adversarial.scope: Bounded active differential-evolution search after graph probes; biased adaptive probes have no failure-probability interpretation. No importance-sampling estimator.

uncertainty.aleatoric: Synthetic IID demand, head and correlated outage variability; Wilson intervals conditional on fixed geometry/friction model
uncertainty.epistemic: Fixed factor and boundary-head sensitivity envelope; no probability distribution or credible interval claimed
